title: Constrained homomorphism orders
summary: We study partial orders induced by constrained variants of finite graph homomorphisms: monomorphisms, embeddings, full homomorphisms, vertex-surjective, edge-surjective and surjective homomorphisms, and locally injective, locally surjective and locally bijective homomorphisms. For each order we ask for analogues of the standard structural properties of the graph homomorphism order: canonical cores, past- or future-finiteness, universality, gaps and finite dualities.
